text: There are cables running from the access computer to the warhead behind it.
source_text:
There are cables running from the access computer to
 the warhead behind it.

text: You have armed the warhead. A timer with four minutes has started a count down.
source_text:
You have armed the warhead. A timer with four minutes
 has started a count down.

text: You have disarmed the nuclear warhead.
source_text: You have disarmed the nuclear warhead.

text: BOOOOOOOOOM! [You have set off the nuke!]
source_text: BOOOOOOOOOM! [You have set off the nuke!]

text: That doesn't seem to be working.
source_text: That doesn't seem to be working.

text: The count down is still going . . . maybe you should cut that red wire.
source_text: The count down is still going . . . maybe you should cut that red wire.

text: Maybe you need to use the key also.
source_text: Maybe you need to use the key also.

text: This is a nuclear warhead. It is controlled by the computer attached by the cables.
source_text:
This is a nuclear warhead. It is controlled by the computer attached
 by the cables.

text: There is nothing on this nuclear warhead that needs repairing.
source_text: There is nothing on this nuclear warhead that needs repairing.

text: There is nothing on this nuclear warhead that can be lockpicked.
source_text: There is nothing on this nuclear warhead that can be lockpicked.

text: This is a very big trap that cannot be disarmed or armed from here.
source_text: This is a very big trap that cannot be disarmed or armed from here.
